subject: POC readiness & gate criteria — next steps and owners
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightlane.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: POC readiness & gate criteria — next steps and owners

Hi Sarah — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a concrete POC plan so we’re aligned before kickoff: 

Summary of goals (from today)
- Verify integration with BrightLane ingestion pipeline and ensure stable inference throughput for 10k daily inference requests.
- Validate quality against your NPS-style rubric (fewer than 8% false-positives in the top-3 suggestions).
- Meet performance SLOs: 95th percentile latency < 200 ms for 128-token requests.

Proposed success gates (actionable, pass/fail):
1) Data connectivity: secure S3 + VPC allowlists validated and sample data ingested (owner: BrightLane IT).
2) Functionality: Redwood model responds to 95% of test prompts with acceptable label per your rubric (owner: BrightLane Product).
3) Performance: sustained throughput of 50 rps with P95 latency < 200 ms in our dedicated test window (owner: Redwood SE - Rafael).
4) Ops: logging, cost metrics, and rollback plan confirmed (owner: Marissa).

POC timeline (target cadence)
- Week 0 (Nov 8): Kickoff + environment access + baseline run (agree test dataset + success rubric).
- Week 1 (Nov 9–15): Integration & ingest; first integration check-in.
- Week 2 (Nov 16–22): Model config tuning, latency optimizations, initial quality readout.
- Week 3 (Nov 23–29): Final readout + decision meeting (go/no-go).

Weekly check-ins: Wed 11:00 AM PT (30 min) — we’ll send recurring invite after you confirm.

Attachments: BrightLane_POC_SuccessCriteria.xlsx (success metric spreadsheet), redwood_network_requirements.pdf (network/KMS checklist).

Immediate asks for Sarah:
- Confirm owners for Data connectivity and Product validation by Wed, Nov 4.
- Confirm kickoff availability for Nov 8 or suggest alternative date.

If that reads well I’ll send the calendar invite and a short SOW-lite (one page) to capture scope/constraints.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
[Attachment: BrightLane_POC_SuccessCriteria.xlsx]
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightlane.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLane POC Team <poc@brightlane.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness & gate criteria — next steps and owners

Thanks Neha — this is exactly the level of detail we need. Quick responses: 
- Owners: Data connectivity = Omar Patel (IT), Product validation = Keisha Morales (Product PM). I’ve looped them into the POC alias.
- Nov 8 kickoff works for us (10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET).

On success criteria: we will own the rubric labels but want Redwood to confirm that the P95 latency target is achievable on your dedicated test capacity — is Rafael able to validate with a dry run?

We will review the attachments and get back with any questions by Wed.

—Sarah
Sarah Lin
Director, Data Products | BrightLane
sarah.lin@brightlane.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightlane.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC readiness & gate criteria — next steps and owners

On Tue, Nov 2, 2026 at 4:12 PM Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightlane.com> wrote:
> On success criteria: we will own the rubric labels but want Redwood to confirm that the P95 latency target is achievable on your dedicated test capacity — is Rafael able to validate with a dry run?

Yes — I can run a short validation on our dedicated nodes before the kickoff. Action plan:
- Wed Nov 4: baseline load test against a small synthetic set (we’ll measure P50/P95/P99).
- Thu Nov 5: share a short report (csv + one-slide summary) and recommended instance profile.

Note: to be conservative, if your payloads are > 256 tokens we should expect a ~20% bump in latency — please let me know typical request sizes.

Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood_network_requirements.pdf]
From: Keisha Morales <keisha.morales@brightlane.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightlane.com>
Cc: BrightLane POC Team <poc@brightlane.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness & gate criteria — next steps and owners

Thanks everyone — I’m Keisha (Product PM). A few clarifying points from our side: 
1) Test dataset: we’ll provide a 500-row sample CSV with 4 columns (user_text, context_id, expected_label, priority) by end of day Thu Nov 5.
2) Rubric: BrightLane considers top-3 suggestion precision most important; we’ll provide the acceptance thresholds in the spreadsheet.
3) Security: Omar will reach out to Rafael separately for VPC allowlist and KMS key exchange.

We confirm kickoff Nov 8 at 10:00 AM PT. Please send the recurring invite and a calendar item with links.

Keisha Morales
Product Manager | BrightLane
keisha.morales@brightlane.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: BrightLane POC Team <poc@brightlane.com>, Keisha Morales <keisha.morales@brightlane.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightlane.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC readiness & gate criteria — next steps and owners

Perfect — tallying next steps and owners: 
- Data connectivity (S3 + VPC allowlist): Omar Patel (BrightLane) / Rafael to validate network checklist (due Nov 5).
- Test dataset + rubric: Keisha Morales (BrightLane) (sample due Nov 5).
- Performance validation & instance recommendation: Rafael Mendes (Redwood) — baseline report due Nov 5.
- Ops/observability & go/no-go facilitation: Marissa Cole (Redwood).

I’ll: 
- Send the Nov 8 kickoff invite for 10:00 AM PT (recurring weekly Wed 11:00 AM PT after kickoff).
- Upload the one-page SOW and calendar ics to the drive folder and share DocuSign link for the SOW-lite.

Next: Rafael — once you post the baseline report I’ll attach it to the drive folder and forward to the BrightLane team.

Thanks all — excited to get started.

Neha
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightlane.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Keisha Morales <keisha.morales@brightlane.com>
Cc: BrightLane POC Team <poc@brightlane.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness & gate criteria — next steps and owners

Thanks — confirmed. Omar will ping Rafael with network allowlist details shortly. Also confirming we received the SOW-lite link. I’ll expect the baseline test report from Rafael today and Keisha’s CSV.

One small ask: can Redwood include tokenized cost estimates for the projected throughput in the baseline report? That will help our finance team sign off on the temporary test budget.

—Sarah

[Forwarded attachment stubs: BrightLane_POC_SuccessCriteria.xlsx, redwood_network_requirements.pdf, weekly-checkins-calendar.ics]
